name: Context Menu UI
description: Context menu DOM and interactions. Documents the floating menu structure with item/separator/disabled-item rendering, click-to-select semantics, outside-click dismissal, and the static open-menu tracking that enforces single-menu-at-a-time behavior.

dom.root: .ctx-menu (position:absolute, left:x px, top:y px — positioned at click coordinates relative to viewport)

elements.menu: div.ctx-menu — root menu container, absolute positioned at (x,y)
elements.item: div.ctx-item — clickable menu item with textContent from item.label, fires item.action() on click then calls remove(). Skipped entirely if item.separator is true
elements.disabled_item: div.ctx-item.ctx-disabled — non-clickable item (no click listener bound) with textContent from item.label
elements.separator: div.ctx-sep — visual separator between menu groups, rendered when item.separator is true

interactions.name: select_item
interactions.result: Action executed, menu removed from DOM and openMenus, onClose callback fired

interactions.name: dismiss
interactions.trigger: click anywhere outside .ctx-menu (document-level click listener added with 0ms setTimeout)
interactions.action: Call this.remove() — removes click listener, splices from openMenus, removes element from DOM, fires onClose
interactions.result: Menu dismissed without executing any item action

interactions.name: open_new_menu
interactions.action: Loop static openMenus: remove all existing menus → clear openMenus array → create new .ctx-menu with items → append to document.body → push to openMenus → add document click listener via setTimeout(0)
interactions.result: Only one context menu visible at a time; previous menus cleaned up before new one appears

states.open: .ctx-menu appended to document.body, present in static openMenus array, document click listener (outsideClick) active
states.closed: .ctx-menu removed from document.body and static openMenus array, document click listener removed, onClose callback fired

lifecycle.created_by: new ContextMenu(items, x, y) — instantiated per right-click event
lifecycle.destroyed_by: remove() — item click, outside click, or superseded by new context menu

props.items: ContextMenuItem[] — array of menu items with optional label, action, disabled, separator fields
props.x: number — horizontal position in viewport pixels
props.y: number — vertical position in viewport pixels
